question: Among players with an overall rating above 70, what percentage have both height greater than 180 cm and an average heading accuracy exceeding 75?

prediction.sql:
WITH base_players AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id,
        p.XCL_126 AS height,
        pa.XCL_139 AS heading_accuracy
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE pa.XCL_132 > 70
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        height,
        AVG(heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading
    FROM base_players
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN height > 180 AND avg_heading > 75 THEN player_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(player_id) AS percentage
FROM player_avg

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH base_players AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_122 AS player_id,
        p.XCL_126 AS height,
        pa.XCL_139 AS heading_accuracy
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
    WHERE pa.XCL_132 > 70
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        height,
        AVG(heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading
    FROM base_players
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN height > 180 AND avg_heading > 75 THEN player_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(player_id) AS percentage
FROM player_avg
